data_source: Binance read-only USD-M Futures account and income REST APIs

definitions.annualization_factor: 365 calendar days because crypto markets trade continuously.
definitions.annualized_return: Geometric cumulative return annualized with 365 calendar days.
definitions.annualized_volatility: Sample standard deviation of daily returns multiplied by sqrt(365).
definitions.calmar_ratio: Annualized return divided by the absolute maximum drawdown.
definitions.daily_net_pnl: USDC realized PnL + USDC commission + USDC funding fee for each UTC day.
definitions.daily_return: Daily net PnL divided by reconstructed starting USDC capital; positive same-day transfers are added to the denominator.
definitions.maximum_drawdown: Largest decline from a prior peak in normalized equity.
definitions.performance_scope: Daily realized USDC USD-M Futures performance from 2026-07-01, using UTC day boundaries.
definitions.profit_factor: Sum of positive daily net PnL divided by absolute negative daily net PnL.
definitions.sharpe_ratio: Mean daily return divided by sample daily standard deviation, multiplied by sqrt(365); risk-free rate is 0.
definitions.sortino_ratio: Mean daily return divided by sample downside deviation, multiplied by sqrt(365); target return is 0.
definitions.win_rate: Positive daily net-PnL days divided by non-zero daily net-PnL days.
